Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
Submission: Nosferatu Broker

Name: Nosferatu Broker
Cardtype: Action
Clan: Nosferatu
+1 Stealth Action
Name a card. (This action is directed at your Prey.) If the target Methuselah has any number of copies of that card in their hand, they discard one of them and burn 2 pool.

Flavor text: “Yeah boss. I’m delivering the package as we speak. No, nothing’s wrong.”

Art notes:
A nosferatu in a leather jacket, grinning, is walking away from a ledge on top of a sky scraper. He’s talking to a cell phone. Leaning against the ledge is a drained human, bloodied and obviously dead. The nosferatu is carrying a suitcase. On the handle of the suitcase there’s a half of handcuffs – the other half is still attached to the previous owner’s maimed hand.

World of Darkness reference:
Nosferatu form societies called Broods for protection, and their most important form of affecting the kindred society is by information brokering.

How does this card address a compelling game need?:
This is an action version of Brood of Brokers:
www.vekn.net/forum/expansion-sets-card-ideas/75955-submission-brood-of-brokers
This is to simultaneously offer different versions of the same effect, as was done for example with going anarch or making others red list.

Created by:
Petrus Makkonen, Petro Hirvonen, Petteri Teerikangas
